message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of persistent wiki records informing the creation and refinement of an active agent skill.","description":"A two-column workflow diagram contrasts a gray Persistent Wiki Layer (wiki/) on the left with a green Active Skill Layer (skills/) on the right. The wiki side contains a skill-impact.md proposal history showing a rejected goal-directed-action proposal at Iteration 0 and accepted break-repetition-loop updates at Iterations 1 and 4; logs.md records a rejection, recurring errors, new training evidence, and later acceptance; and patterns summarizes take-examine-move-loop and multi-operation-loop patterns with evidence. Colored arrows connect the records to the active break-repetition-loop skill: red indicates prior rejection history informing its rationale, green indicates accepted skill updates, blue indicates chronological logs of patterns and decisions, and orange indicates documented patterns motivating updates. The active skill contains PURPOSE.md, describing its origin after a more abstract proposal was rejected, and SKILL.md, with a trigger, rules, examples of failing and successful behavior, an anti-pattern, and a fix. A separate other-skill item appears below.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
